_comment: Log signatures. Each regex is matched (case-insensitive) against every engine log message. 'kind': setup | firmware | transient | hardware | info. 'parts' are weighted suspects (0-1). 'stop_stage' marks the stage a failure with this line belongs to. Sources: idevicerestore and libtatsu source strings; see the spec for the reasoning behind each.

signatures.regex: Unable to discover device mode|Unable to discover device type
signatures.title: The engine never saw the phone
signatures.why: No phone answered in DFU, Recovery or normal mode.

signatures.regex: Unable to retrieve device list|Could not connect to usbmuxd|ERROR: Unable to connect to usbmuxd
signatures.title: This PC could not talk to Apple Mobile Device Service
signatures.why: On Windows the engine reaches phones in normal and restore mode through Apple's service on port 27015.

signatures.regex: Firmware file .* cannot be opened|ipsw_open .*: No such file|Firmware file might be corrupt|Unable to extract .* from IPSW|could not extract .* from IPSW|Unable to extract filesystem from IPSW
signatures.title: The IPSW could not be read
signatures.why: The firmware file is missing, incomplete or damaged.

signatures.regex: Unable to find a matching build identity|Could not make sure this firmware is suitable for the current device|firmware file is not compatible
signatures.title: This IPSW is not for this phone
signatures.why: The firmware's build manifest has no entry for this model and board.

signatures.regex: status=(69|94)\b|isn't eligible for the requested build|This device isn.t eligible|No firmwares are currently being signed
signatures.title: Apple is not signing this iOS version for this phone
signatures.why: Apple's signing server answered with 'not eligible' (status 94 or 69). This is not a hardware fault.

signatures.regex: TSS request failed: .*status=-1|Unable to send TSS request|Could not resolve host|Couldn't connect to server|Failed to connect to gs\.apple\.com|Could not fetch list of signed firmwares|Download from https://api\.ipsw\.me.* failed
signatures.title: Apple's signing server could not be reached
signatures.why: The signing request never got an answer, which points to the network, a firewall or the hosts file.

signatures.regex: Unable to get SHSH blobs for this device|Unable to proceed without a TSS record|can't continue without TSS
signatures.title: Signing failed
signatures.why: The engine could not get Apple's signature for this restore.

signatures.regex: Unable to place device into recovery mode from normal mode|Device is in an invalid state
signatures.title: The phone would not switch from normal mode to Recovery
signatures.why: From normal mode the engine needs a trusted, unlocked phone to send it to Recovery.

signatures.regex: Unable to place device into recovery mode from DFU mode|Unable to send iBoot stage 1 components
signatures.title: The phone dropped off during the DFU-to-Recovery hop
signatures.why: This is usually a one-off USB drop while the first bootloader loads; if it repeats, the early boot hardware is suspect.

signatures.regex: Unable to send iBEC|Unable to send APTicket|Unable to get nonce from device|Getting ApNonce failed|Getting SepNonce failed
signatures.title: The bootloader could not be loaded
signatures.why: The phone stopped answering while the boot chain was being sent or read.

signatures.regex: Device did not reconnect in recovery mode|Device did not disconnect\. Possibly invalid iBEC
signatures.title: The phone never came back after loading the bootloader
signatures.why: After the update bootloader was sent, the phone should re-appear in Recovery within a minute.

signatures.regex: Device failed to enter restore mode|Unable to place device into restore mode
signatures.title: The restore OS did not come up
signatures.why: The phone was told to boot the restore ramdisk but never connected in restore mode. The USB watch decides between a phone crash and a PC driver problem.

signatures.regex: Device reconnected in (Recovery|DFU) mode, most likely image personalization failed
signatures.title: The phone fell back to Recovery instead of booting the restore OS
signatures.why: Either the boot images were rejected, or the restore OS panicked and the phone rebooted to Recovery.

signatures.regex: Could not read data \((-?\d+)\)\. Aborting
signatures.title: The phone stopped answering during the restore
signatures.why: The connection to the restore OS dropped; the step it dropped on decides the suspect.

signatures.regex: Unable to send data to ASR|Unable to send filesystem|Unable to send payload to ASR|Failed to send data|usb_bulk_transfer
signatures.title: The transfer of iOS to the phone broke off
signatures.why: Data stopped flowing while iOS was being written. A one-off is usually the cable or port; the same point twice is storage.

signatures.regex: ASR was unable to validate the filesystem
signatures.title: The phone rejected the iOS image check
signatures.why: The restore OS could not validate the image it was about to write.

signatures.regex: Status: Disk Failure
signatures.title: The phone reported a disk failure (status 6)
signatures.why: The restore OS itself said its storage failed.

signatures.regex: Status: Failed to mount filesystems
signatures.title: The phone could not mount its filesystem (status 27)
signatures.why: The restore OS could not mount what it just wrote.

signatures.regex: Status: Verification Error
signatures.title: The phone reported a verification error
signatures.why: What was written did not read back correctly.

signatures.regex: Status: Failed to load SEP Firmware
signatures.title: The Secure Enclave firmware failed to load (status 50/51)
signatures.why: The SEP would not accept its firmware, which usually means a pairing problem between CPU, NAND and secure storage.

signatures.regex: Status: Failed to recover FDR data|Unable to receive message from FDR
signatures.title: Factory data could not be recovered (status 53)
signatures.why: The phone could not restore its factory calibration data (FDR).

signatures.regex: X-Gold Baseband Update Failed|Status: .*Baseband
signatures.title: The baseband update failed (status 1015)
signatures.why: The phone reported that its modem could not be updated.

signatures.regex: Unable to find required Bb(SNUM|ChipID|GoldCertId|Nonce) in parameters|Unable to fetch Baseband TSS|device didn't accept BasebandData
signatures.title: The baseband did not identify itself
signatures.why: The modem has to report its serial and chip ID before Apple can sign its firmware; it did not.

signatures.regex: TSS request failed \(status=(8|49)\b
signatures.title: Apple rejected the baseband's signing data
signatures.why: Status 8 or 49 from the signing server means invalid baseband request data, such as a bad baseband serial.

signatures.regex: ^radio-error=(?!0\b)
signatures.title: iBoot reported a radio (baseband) error before the restore
signatures.why: The bootloader's radio-error value was set, meaning the modem failed on a previous boot.

signatures.regex: Unable to find required SE,(ChipID|ID|Nonce|RootKeyIdentifier) in parameters|Couldn't get SE firmware data|Unable to fetch SE ticket|Unknown SE,ChipID
signatures.title: The Secure Element did not answer
signatures.why: The SE has to report its ID and nonce for Apple to sign its firmware.

signatures.regex: Unable to find required (Savage|Yonkers)[^ ]* in parameters|Couldn't get (Savage|Yonkers|Jasmine|YonkersIR1) firmware data|Unable to fetch (Savage|Yonkers) ticket|Could not determine (Savage|Yonkers) firmware component
signatures.title: The Face ID module did not answer
signatures.why: The biometric camera module has to report its ID before its firmware can be signed and sent.

signatures.regex: Couldn't get Rose firmware data|Unable to fetch Rose ticket
signatures.title: The UWB chip update failed
signatures.why: The Ultra Wideband chip (Rose) could not be prepared for its firmware.

signatures.regex: Couldn't get Veridian firmware data|Unable to fetch Veridian ticket
signatures.title: The battery management update failed
signatures.why: The battery management unit (Veridian) could not be prepared for its firmware.

signatures.regex: restored crashed, backtrace following
signatures.title: The restore daemon on the phone crashed
signatures.why: The phone sent a crash backtrace; it is kept with the case.

signatures.regex: Checkpoint FAILURE id: (0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+) result=(-?\d+)
signatures.title: A restore checkpoint failed
signatures.why: The phone marked one of its internal restore checkpoints as failed.

signatures.regex: No space left on device|not enough space
signatures.title: Out of disk space
signatures.why: The PC or the phone ran out of space while preparing the restore.

activities.regex: About to send filesystem|Sending filesystem now|Connected to ASR|Validating the filesystem
About to send BasebandData|Sending Baseband TSS request|Updating Baseband in progress
About to send FDR Trust data
